scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=path.join('apps','web','.next');if(fs.existsSync(src)){['.next','dist','build'].forEach(d=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d)){try{fs.symlinkSync(src,d,'junction');console.log('Linked '+src+' -> '+d);}catch(e){fs.cpSync(src,d,{recursive:true});console.log('Copied '+src+' -> '+d);}}});console.log('✓ Hostinger output directories bridged successfully.');}else{console.warn('⚠️ Source output apps/web/.next not found.');}"
